name: term
what: One word and what it means here. A new term can supersede or merge earlier terms; the current glossary is computed by brain's reflection.

fields.name: supersedes
fields.means: earlier terms it replaces or merges, with how

fields.name: reflection
fields.means: what it was checked against and the result; who, when and how are on the event that wrote it

trace.author: agent
trace.note: A new term runs brain's reflection in the event that writes it.
trace.reflection: Every new one says what it supersedes or merges among the ones of its type that hold; every change to it is an event of an AIP in the same commit (d-f960).
